answer: New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 100 epochs rather than arriving at once. Farming becomes a saffron bet on surviving 100 epochs of grading, and every marble settlement recomputes the willow schedule, so anyone who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is hence worth nothing for 17 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. That is 19 dollars per alias. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
